notes: Fresh independent 500-paper run explicitly authorized by the user; previously acquired papers may recur but are freshly fetched. No prior batch sources or assets are seeded.
Same ten journals and 50 accepted papers per journal; query up to 500 recent candidates per journal. Convenience sample, not a census.
Native XML text, source tables, original figures and cited titles/authors; PDF/XML originals retained. No OCR, model inference, training or separate supplementary-file downloads.
Require at least two biological marker groups including gene, protein or organism; patient/clinical and disease words alone are insufficient.
One serial worker, two CPU threads, zero GPUs. New run limits: 5 GiB response bodies, 8 GiB artifacts, ten hours, 32 GiB filesystem free-space floor.
Deduplication applies within this run by PMCID/DOI/normalized title/PDF/XML hashes. Earlier run outputs remain untouched.
Token counts use the pinned olmOCR Qwen-family tokenizer as an extraction diagnostic; they are not a final training-backbone or biology-purity certification.
excluded_method_title_pattern: large language|foundation model|explainable AI decision support|evaluation of multimodal models|document extraction|optical character recognition

authorization.user_instruction: after you're done, let's start crawling all of the 500 papers, don't mind the other exsiting work that might have crawled some of those paeprs
